title: Message in a bottle
lines: How time flies, and Arknights will soon be celebrating its 3rd birthday with all Doctors, who have continued to show love and support. On this joyous occasion, all Doctors are invited to join in the Message In A Bottle event. Feel free to stuff your blessings or thoughts into the drift bottle as a Message. May your good wishes float far and wide throughout Terra.
Official Website: https://messageinabottle.arknights.global/
*For the best experience, please access the website on your PC with the browser window maximized.
Event Description
Write A Message : Use text, stickers, and drawings to make your messages with good wishes and thoughts for the new year on the official event page ( up to 3 messages ).

Catch A Message : After submitting your first message, you can then go ask Projekt Red to catch others' messages for you. Please read and give likes to the messages sent by other doctors from the Terra ( up to 30 readings per day ; the limit will be lifted at the final phase of the event). The more you read, the more chances you have to be surprised!
"Voice of Terra" : Check the likes received from others in Terra ( update data at 12:00 and 0:00 daily ).
How To Participate In The Sweepstakes
1. Make your message at the website and submit it, and then share the event or the message you received from Projekt Red on Twitter/Facebook with #Messageinabottle to participate in the sweepstakes.
2. After the event concludes, 50 people randomly picked from those who have reposted the content successfully will be awarded.
Rewards
50 people in total, each receiving:
Orundum * 600
$50 Google Play/Apple Gift Card
Note
1. Each submission must consist of customized text as well as drawings and stickers provided by the website. Messages that lack customized text or are filled with spam only will be invalidated.
2. Submissions with content related to politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, controversy, or those violating the rules will be invalidated. Commercial contents are also prohibited.

3. By submitting the message, the creator agrees to allow Yostar the right to use the work in official Arknights content or on its and its affiliates' social platform accounts. The ownership of the work and other rights remain with the creator.

4. The final explanation of the activity belongs to Yostar Games, the operation team of Arknights. If players find any violations against the rules or have any questions, please feel free to contact us: arknights.event@yo-star.com .
